card.name: "or" in avoid-food-or-drink warnings
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after "Avoid food" (before drink containing grapefruit), and similar "or" in "fire, flames or smoking" or "heat or flame". Also "any" in "if any".

modes.label: The warning about food or drink
modes.description: The word "or" joining "food" and "drink" in grapefruit avoidance instructions.
modes.example: Avoid food<< or>> drink containing grapefruit during treatment with IB

modes.label: Heat or flame warnings
modes.description: "or" joining fire-related hazards in flammable product warnings.
modes.example: Avoid fire, flames<< or>> smoking until the gel has dried since alcohol

modes.label: "if any" hedges
modes.description: The word "any" in phrases like "if any" when describing uncertain effects.
modes.example: The effects, if<< any>>, on the pituitary-gon
